The [[Zaishen Mission]] [[signpost]] is an [[NPC]] that offers a different daily [[Zaishen Challenge Quest]] for gold, title points, experience, and [[Copper Zaishen Coin]]s. You can get the quest rewards from [[Zehnchu]] at the [[Great Temple of Balthazar]] or [[Embark Beach]].

==Locations==
*[[The Battle Isles]]
**{{NPC location|Embark Beach}}
**{{NPC location|Great Temple of Balthazar}}

==Quests==
* The current available quest, as of {{#time: H:i, j F Y }} (UTC), is [[ {{Cycle|ZMission}} (Zaishen quest)]].

The available quest changes daily, based on a recurring cycle. For a quick overview of which quests will be available in the next days, see [[Zaishen Challenge Quest]]s. For all available quests, see the [[:Category:Zaishen Mission quests|category listing]] and for information about the current or previous cycles, see the [[Zaishen Mission/cycles|cycles subpage]].

: '''''Note:''' To ensure that the correct quest is displayed, if the UTC time shown above is not close to the UTC clock time at the top of the page,  you can [{{fullurl:{{FULLPAGENAME}}|action=purge}} refresh/purge this page].
==Dialogue==
===[[Roleplaying character|PvE characters]]===
:"''This is the signpost where Zaishen Mission quests are posted.''"

Alternative with no quests available:
:"''There are no more quests available here today, but other signs may have more postings from the Zaishen.''"

Alternative when you already have the maximum number of quests:
:"''The Zaishen only allow 3 missions to be undertaken at one time.''"

When asked about a quest:
:"''The battle rages on! All able-bodied heroes should hasten to defend those bravely protecting [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]]''."

===[[PvP-only character|PvP characters]]===
:"''The signpost speaks of far off lands which you have no interest in as a PvP Character.''" {{sic|"Character" is capitalized}}

==Notes==
* The [[bonus]]/master reward objective is separate from the [[Hard mode]] objective, which means you can complete the bonus/master reward in [[Normal mode]] and complete the mission without the bonus/master reward objective in Hard mode and still gain both bonus objectives for the quest.

{{bug|After a [[character]] has accepted the quest reward, they will lose the opportunity to take the quest the next time it appears in the cycle if they did not do any of the following:
* change [[district]]s, 
* [[zone]], or
* [[Log Out|log out]] of the account<sup>1</sup> and log back in.
}}
<sup>1: Switching to the [[character selection screen]] won't count.</sup>
